query: which module maps the numeric failure codes returned by storage scripts to named constants?
where are all message types an isolated processor can send back to the main process listed?
why: enum ParentCommand: Completed, Failed, InitFailed, Progress, Log, MoveToDelayed, GetChildrenValues, ...

query: which file defines the type describing how many or how old finished jobs should be retained?
why: type KeepJobs {count} | {age, count?, limit?} with best-effort removal docs

query: what is the entry script inside an isolated child that dispatches init, start and cancel commands and handles termination signals and uncaught exceptions?
why: default export wiring ChildProcessor to receiver messages, SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers and uncaughtException -> Failed

query: which module loads SQL text for schema migrations and runtime statements from disk and caches it?
why: loadMigrationSql / loadCommandSql reading .sql from migrations/ and commands/ with Map caches

query: where is the ordered list of database schema migrations and the highest known schema version declared?
why: Migration interface, MIGRATIONS array (0001_schema, 0002_functions, 0003_dedup_stale_key) and LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION

query: which contract describes the datastore-agnostic operations every storage adapter must implement for queues, workers and jobs?
why: IQueueBackend interface (move to active, extend locks, promote, ...) and related backend types

query: which module builds the default Redis-based storage adapter, including a dedicated blocking connection, and lets callers override the process-wide default?
which file defines the tree shape of parent and child jobs and restricts which options nested nodes may use?
why: FlowJobBase, FlowParentJob/FlowNestedLeafJob/FlowRoot* types omitting deduplication/parent/repeat, FlowOpts

query: where are the attribute names attached to tracing spans declared?
which module defines the pluggable tracing and metrics abstraction modeled on OpenTelemetry, with tracer, context manager and meter?
why: Telemetry interface with tracer, contextManager, optional meter, plus Tracer/ContextManager/Span/Meter interfaces

query: how do I get queue, worker and event classes bound to a particular storage backend without changing the global default?
why: BackendClasses interface and withBackend(factory) returning backend-typed Queue/Worker/QueueEvents/FlowProducer constructors
